title: Interaction: a buy funded by a same-basket sale must net against post-sale funds
instruction: sell 10 shares of my AVGO and buy $4,000 of AAPL
notes:
Cash account, buying_power 3000.00 (== cash, no unsettled funds). AVGO: 50 sh @ 500.00 = 25000.00, opened_at 2024-08-27 (2 years before as_of, not a day trade). Equity = 3000.00 + 25000.00 = 28000.00.

A system that checks the AAPL buy order in isolation against the PRE-TRADE buying_power (4000.00 > 3000.00) would wrongly BLOCK it. Correct: the basket also sells 10 AVGO in the same run, freeing 10 * 500.00 = 5000.00. Post-sale funds available for the buy = 3000.00 (pre-trade buying_power) + 5000.00 (same-basket sale proceeds) = 8000.00, which covers the 4000.00 AAPL buy with 4000.00 to spare. R1 must net sales against buys WITHIN the same basket before checking the remainder against buying power -- this case exists specifically to punish a per-order check. Expected decision is ALLOW: nothing actually fires.

Concentration: AAPL 4000.00 / equity 28000.00 = 14.29% (cap 15%) -- under cap, no R3. AVGO sell only reduces AVGO's weight, cannot trigger R3. No existing open orders (no R4). No day trade: AVGO held 2 years, AAPL is a new buy not a same-day round trip (no R2). No realized-loss history on AAPL or AVGO (no R5). Market open (no R6). Both symbols tradable (no R7). Nothing fires; ALLOW.
